title: Shield of the Undevout
summary: +2 AC, an extra level 1 spell slot and Disadvantage on enemy fear saves.

fields.Shield Bash: When hit by a melee attack, spend a Reaction. The attacker makes a Strength save against your spell save DC or falls Prone for 1 turn. The tooltip instead names Dexterity.
fields.Additional Spell Slot: +1 level 1 spell slot. The source reports each character can gain it once per Long Rest, with an exception when converting the slot to a Sorcery Point.
fields.Dreadful Hewer: Foes have disadvantage on saves against your actions or spells that inflict Fearful or Frightened.
